foot_text: EXS World Tour is a game by EXSports Oy for Android. The S and M slopes are free; the L slope is a one-time purchase of €1.95.
home_title: EXS World Tour – the snowboard game where clean wins
home_desc: A Big Air snowboard game for Android. Learn the tricks, watch the world's best runs and chase your own place on the world ranking.
hero_lead: The cleaner the run, the higher the score. A snowboard game where tricks are scored from the movement itself, not from a button press.
ticker_aria: Top of the world ranking, Small S
step1_p: Crouch in the in-run, pop at the lip. Timing decides height, and height gives you time for the trick.
step2_p: Spin and flip on their own sliders, grab with a button: Nose, Tail, Indy or Weddle. Hold the grab for at least 0.2 seconds and let go before the snow.
step3_p: Board straight and rotation finished before the snow. A clean landing banks the points; a crash wipes them.
fair_p: Every result is recomputed on the server from the player's inputs. The number the game shows is not enough, and every ranked run can be watched.
how_title: How to play – EXS World Tour
how_desc: Getting started, controls, pop, grabs and landing. The seven tutorial steps and the career track.
how_intro: The game starts with a tutorial that teaches the run, the pop, the grab and the first tricks in seven steps. The tutorial uses the S and M kickers, and the career track opens after it.
start_steps: Pick the current exercise and read Do this and Why?.
Watch example shows the inputs for the same task. Watching does not count as a completion.
Start the exercise and press Go on the slope. In steps 5–7, set the flip or spin before you go.
A success is saved before the next task. Completed tasks can be repeated.
controls: Crouch in the in-run: the slider on the left, the fill shows how deep you are.
Pop near the lip. Your timing shows as feedback in the air; a perfect pop is PERFECT.
Spin and flip on their own sliders. Direction FS or BS, amount in 180° steps.
Grabs Nose, Tail, Indy and Weddle are buttons during the air. A grab needs a hold of at least 0.2 seconds, and the hold time affects rotation.
Landing is Clean, Sketchy or a crash. Let go of the grab before the snow.
controls_p: In Play mode every jump starts with the sliders reset. The rider sets off as soon as you touch any control on the start screen.
lessons: Press Go and follow the jump with the preset settings.
Press Pop near the lip and release as instructed.
Hold Indy in the air and let go before the ground.
Combine a timed pop with an Indy grab.
Set a front flip; hold Nose in the air and let go before the ground.
Set an FS 360; hold Indy and let go before the ground.
Half a rotation frontside, hold Indy and aim the landing with a small counter-spin.
career_p: After the tutorial, Play opens the career. The four S tasks unlock the M slope, and the six M tasks unlock the L tasks.
wr_p: When a result is ready for the ranking, submit it from the result card in the game. The server recomputes the score from your inputs, and the verified result appears on the world ranking under your nickname.
list_desc: The world's best runs on the S, M and L slopes. Every result is verified on the server.
own_p: Sign-in with a Google account opens when the test season starts. You need an account and a nickname to submit results.
rules: One best result per player on each slope.
The server recomputes scores from the inputs. Only verified results are shown.
Only the Android game installed from Google Play qualifies.
When the season changes, the ranking starts empty and the old season moves to the archive.
run_desc: A server-verified run from the EXS World Tour world ranking.
run_notice: Sample page. Real runs open at worldtour.exsports.fi/s/<id> when the test season starts.
coach: Spin 2° short · Grab held the whole air · Perfect pop · Clean stomp
share_p: The link opens without the game or a sign-in.
how_scored_p: The server replayed the player's inputs and computed the score itself. The video was rendered on the player's device from the same jump.
terms_desc: Terms of use for the EXS World Tour world ranking.
terms_notice: The terms of use will be published on this page before the test season starts. Below is a summary of the principles.
terms: Taking part in the world ranking requires being 13 or older and a Google account. Playing without an account is always possible.
Nicknames are public. An offensive or impersonating nickname, or one containing personal data, is changed, and repeated violations lead to a submission ban.
Only runs you played yourself on an unmodified game qualify. The server recomputes every result.
The test season ends when the game launches, and the rankings start empty then.
privacy_notice: The privacy policy will be published on this page before the test season starts.
privacy_p1: The controller is EXSports Oy. For the world ranking we process your Google account identifier, nickname, submitted runs and their data. Data is stored in Google Firebase in the EU. Only the nickname and the run are shown publicly.
privacy_p2: The notice covering playtest telemetry is in the game's consent screen. Contact
account_desc: Deleting your EXS World Tour account.
account_p: The world ranking account is created with a Google account in the game or on this site when the test season starts. You can delete the account from the game's settings or from this page after signing in. Deletion removes the nickname, results, replays and videos.
account_notice: Sign-in and account deletion will open here when the service is live. Until then, send requests to
